title: A causal magnetic black hole with finite self-energy
summary: We construct a nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) model for a static magnetic black hole. Rather than imposing a regular center, we require a Maxwell weak-field limit, finite magnetic self-energy, a positive and subluminal electromagnetic cone, the standard energy conditions, and a static exterior that satisfies known sufficient stability criteria. A positive mixture of power kernels restricts the exponent to $1/4<γ\leq1/2$.
